instructions:
Engine: griffon. Copy each game into its own directory under /sd/roms/scummvm, then use Add Game in this engine.

File sets differ by game, platform and release. Follow the official game data-file page; a folder existing alone does not prove the game is complete.

https://docs.scummvm.org/en/latest/use_scummvm/game_files.html
https://wiki.scummvm.org/index.php/Datafiles

Freeware download choices are optional; engines without an included freeware choice require your selected game data. No console ROM or BIOS is bundled.

Download matching engine / launcher resources first. These live under /sd/scummvm, separate from game directories. This does not supply a commercial game. PAX saves are under /sd/scummvm/saves.
